series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: By 2021, early adopter brands that redesign their websites to support visual- and voice-search will increase digital commerce revenue by 30 percent.
entries.subject: Visual and voice search
entries.metric: increase in digital commerce revenue for early adopter brands

entries.quote: By 2020, five of the top seven digital giants will willfully "self-disrupt" to create their next leadership opportunity.
entries.subject: Digital giant self-disruption
entries.metric: number of top seven digital giants that self-disrupt

entries.quote: By the end of 2020, the banking industry will derive $1 billion in business value from the use of blockchain-based cryptocurrencies.
entries.subject: Blockchain cryptocurrencies in banking
entries.metric: business value derived by banking industry

entries.quote: By 2022, most people in mature economies will consume more false information than true information.
entries.subject: False information consumption
entries.note: Most people in mature economies consume more false than true information.

entries.quote: By 2020, AI-driven creation of "counterfeit reality," or fake content, will outpace AI's ability to detect it, fomenting digital distrust.
entries.subject: Counterfeit reality / deepfakes
entries.note: AI creation of fake content outpaces AI detection.

entries.quote: By 2021, more than 50 percent of enterprises will be spending more per annum on bots and chatbot creations than traditional mobile app developments.
entries.subject: Chatbot spending
entries.metric: share of enterprises spending more on bots and chatbots than mobile apps

entries.quote: By 2021, 40 percent of IT staff will be versatilists, holding multiple roles, most of which will be business, rather than technology-related.
entries.subject: IT versatilists
entries.metric: share of IT staff that are versatilists

entries.quote: In 2020, AI will become a positive net job motivator, creating 2.3 million jobs while eliminating only 1.8 million jobs.
entries.subject: AI net job creation
entries.metric: jobs created vs eliminated by AI

entries.quote: By 2020, IoT technology will be in 95 percent of electronics for new product designs.
entries.subject: IoT in electronics
entries.metric: share of new electronics product designs with IoT technology

entries.quote: Through 2022, half of all security budgets for IoT will go to fault remediation, recalls and safety failures rather than protection.
entries.subject: IoT security budgets
entries.metric: share of IoT security budgets going to remediation, recalls and safety failures

notes: Edition covers '2018 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: 10 (press release: 'top 10 strategic predictions'). Found in public source: 10 top predictions.
